embed.title: !unregister
embed.description: Delete your account and everything with it. This can't be undone.

fields.name: Usage
fields.value: `{{prefix}}unregister` — deletes your registration with all your tracking rules, profiles, saved locations and summary schedules. To come back you have to `{{prefix}}poracle` again and start from scratch.

fields.name: Softer alternative
fields.value: To just stop alerts for a while, use `{{prefix}}stop`. Everything is kept, and `{{prefix}}start` turns alerts back on.

fields.name: {{#if userIsAdmin}}Admins{{/if}}
fields.value: {{#if userIsAdmin}}`{{prefix}}unregister <id> <id>` — unregister others by ID{{#if isDiscord}} or @mention{{/if}}. Admins can't unregister themselves this way, and `{{prefix}}unregister` on its own does nothing for an admin. Give bare IDs, not `user:<id>`.{{/if}}
